song.title: The Things (That) I Used To Do

guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: extremely well documented — SRV's well-worn 1963/1962-hybrid Strat nicknamed "Number One" is among the most famous guitars in blues-rock.

tone.target: SRV Texas blues overdrive with wah bite and tight sustain
tone.profile: SRV Texas blues overdrive with wah bite and tight sustain
tone.summary: A classic blues setup using a Tube Screamer style boost, Wah pedal for accenting, and an AC30-style amp paired with a vintage 4x12 cabinet to achieve the necessary mid-pushed grit and sustain.
corrections: swap clean Twin base for pushed Fender breakup
keep it gritty, not generic lead
